text: Welcome to the clinic. I understand you are experiencing fatigue, difficulty concentrating, and abnormal blood findings. To help me diagnose your condition, can you describe any specific changes you've noticed in your energy levels or cognitive function over the past few weeks?

speaker: Doctor
text: You mentioned digital pain that improves with cold; please describe the specific color and texture changes you see on your fingers when they are exposed to the cold. Also, have you noticed any shortness of breath, pale skin, or unusual bruising?

speaker: Patient
text: My main symptom is Fatigue and difficulty to concentrate. I also have Dyspnea on exertion, Dizziness, Digital pain that improves with cold.

text:

While we await the CBC and ESR results you requested, have you noticed any thickening of your skin, particularly on your hands or face, or any difficulty swallowing?
